summary: Romance of the Underworld is a 1928 American silent drama produced and distributed by Fox Film Corporation, directed by Irving Cummings and starring Mary Astor. The film is adapted from the 1918 stage play "A Romance of the Underworld" by Paul Armstrong. An earlier 1918 film version, directed by James Kirkwood with Catherine Calvert in Astor's role, was also made, and the 1928 film survives in archives including the Museum of Modern Art.
one_line: A 1928 American silent drama directed by Irving Cummings and starring Mary Astor, adapted from a Paul Armstrong stage play.
key_facts: Romance of the Underworld is a 1928 American silent film drama.
The film was produced and distributed by Fox Film Corporation.
The film was directed by Irving Cummings.
Mary Astor starred in Romance of the Underworld.
The 1928 film is taken from a stage play called "A Romance of the Underworld" by Paul Armstrong.
A previous version of the story was filmed as "A Romance of the Underworld" in 1918.
The 1918 version was directed by James Kirkwood.
Catherine Calvert played Mary Astor's part in the 1918 version.
The 1928 film is extant at the Museum of Modern Art.
The 1928 film is also extant in a European archive.
